Calculate hires values from peptide data

calculate_hires.Rd

Calculate hires values from peptide data

Usage

calculate_hires(
  fit_values,
  method = c("shortest", "weighted", "weighted_by_rss", "weighted_by_log_rss"),
  if_convention = check_convention_usage(fit_values),
  protein_length = max(fit_values[["end"]]),
  fractional = FALSE
)

Examples

kin_dat <- HRaDeX::prepare_kin_dat(alpha_dat,
                                   state = "Alpha_KSCN",
                                   time_0 = 0,
                                   time_100 = 1440)
fit_values <- create_fit_dataset(kin_dat,
                                 fit_k_params = get_example_fit_k_params())
calculate_hires(fit_values, method = "shortest")
